A2_locate_001.rule: reuse results/frame_update.csv read-only; else rebuild via same code path

A3_grd_concept.rule: Merged sheet; Taxes excl SC (%GDP) col24; Income (%GDP) col32; Trade (%GDP) col48; same concept as 001 seam S1

A4_coverage_count.rule: merged estimation N (composite + X0 war/dem/parl + 4 legal-origin dummies, non-missing) per Q2 composite; N>=80 -> verdicted column; N<80 -> not separable (coverage), reported descriptively with N on every surface
A4_coverage_count.note: mcollective16 N=67 < 80 -> not separable (coverage) by the 001 G5 rule, as pre-declared in spec II.1(2); its estimates are still computed and reported descriptively with N=67 stated.

A5_q1_method.spec: Pooled STACKED OLS of era-mean income-tax(%GDP) on era-mean private credit, stacking the E0 and E2 country observations, with an E2 era dummy and a credit x E2 interaction; HC1 robust SEs. The interaction coefficient IS the E2-vs-E0 slope difference and its HC1 two-sided p-value is the slope-difference test used by Q1 verdict step 3. (Single-equation stack equivalent to the SUR cross-equation slope-equality test when the two eras share the regressor set; HC1 makes it heteroskedasticity-robust.)
A5_q1_method.decided_on: common-sample variant (countries present in all three eras); full-sample reported beside it
